description:
From fz-t93.26's paper (M5). Re-scoped 2026-11-24 (page ../fz-t93.28.html, user accepted all three decisions).

Cause: ties in the compiler's fixed executable order are broken by raw FunctionId (mint order, which follows job order): ActivationKey::semantic_cmp (semantic.rs:968), FunctionId::semantic_cmp (:974-977), ExecutableSymbol::semantic_cmp (transport.rs:240). That decides printed w{n}/xN numbers and the published wrapper order (TransportPosition::semantic_cmp transport.rs:376, backend_program.rs:97) that the runtime indexes (jobs/native.rs:158, ir_interp/backend.rs:2882).

Build A2 (scratch t93_28/variantA.patch, A2_full.diff): Types::cmp_function orders two functions by their registered typed origin (loud assert on distinct functions with equal origins), used by the three semantic_cmps. Tests that mint stand-in FunctionIds register a real origin via cfg(test) Types::test_function (define_test_callable); no fallback in cmp_function. drive_test.rs:14220 gains a PopOrder::Lifo pass for its perturbation precondition; backend/output/facts compared across all passes, work multiset only across root orders.
Done when: 01574 in ORDER_FREE_PLANS, identical fifo/lifo; census 14->13 none new; pins only fall (work_start_reason 2484->2482 and 418/420->416/418, public_trace 00420 cold walks 476->474, fz2_cli 00420 runtime_demand_walks 631->629; distiller requests fall).

comments.text: PR #868 (6ddedefe6) HOLD, from fz-engine: JSON's ten-order sweep shows 01353 under seed 5 overflows the stack or hangs on #868's head; develop and #869 exit 0 on the same seed. CI misses it because 01353 is not in ORDER_FREE_PLANS. Diagnosis in ../fz-edge (A/B: cut change vs ordering change). t93.7.2 stays blocked.

Hold lifted (fz-engine): the 01353 seeded hang is pre-existing (develop e8a9b9828 hangs at seed 24, same stack: unbounded list-emptiness recursion under fold_clashes_against_standing_row -> clash_fold_join). A/B clears the transport cut; #868's ActivationKey order only changes which seeds hit it (5,36 vs 24; ~1 in 40 before and after).

title: Functions are ordered by their typed origin, not by when their ids were minted
